scenario: I am a construction worker. I and my crew are standing on some scaffolding, working on a skyscraper. Suddenly, the scaffolding collapses partially. I and several others are hanging on to a dangling crossbar, but it cannot hold the weight of all of us. A worker next to me slips off the crossbar and grabs my one free arm. However, I realize that the entire structure is about to give way. If I repeatedly kick my coworker in the stomach and chest until he lets go of my hand and falls, I will remove just enough weight so the rest of me can make it to safety before the scaffolding collapses entirely. This will kill my colleague but it will save me and the others.
